title: Global Humidity Normalization
scenario: Determine for each city how many days it remained within the 25th-75th percentile of global humidity for that month.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, humidity NUMERIC)
hint: Calculate global percentiles per month using PERCENTILE_CONT().
correctQuery: SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT city_name, humidity, DATE_TRUNC('month', reading_date) as mon, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY humidity) OVER(PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', reading_date)) as p25, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY humidity) OVER(PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', reading_date)) as p75 FROM weather_data) t WHERE humidity BETWEEN p25 AND p75 GROUP BY city_name;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, humidity NUMERIC);
